question: An economist and a renowned literary personality with a vast reader base in India and abroad, Prof. Arunoday Saha, who was honoured with Padma Shri in 2025, belongs to which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prof. Arunoday Saha** is an acclaimed economist and literary figure with a vast reader base both in **India and abroad**.
 
• He was recognized for his contributions and achievements by being honored with the prestigious **Padma Shri award in 2025**.
 
• Prof. Arunoday Saha belongs to the state of **Tripura**, which is located in northeastern India.
 
• Tripura is known for its rich cultural heritage and has produced many notable personalities in various fields, including literature and economics.
 
• The Padma Shri award is one of the **highest civilian honors** in India, given for distinguished contributions in various disciplines, including arts, literature, science, and social services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tripura:**

 
 
• Tripura is one of the **seven northeastern states** of India, bordered by Bangladesh to the north, south, and west.
 
• It is known for its **cultural diversity, tribal communities, and historical significance**.
 
• The state capital is **Agartala**, and the official languages are Bengali and Kokborok.
 
• Tripura has a rich literary tradition and has produced many renowned writers and scholars.
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri Award:**
 
 
• The Padma Shri is the **fourth highest civilian award** in India, established in **1954**.
 
• It is awarded by the Government of India for contributions in **various fields**, such as arts, education, literature, science, sports, social work, and public affairs.
 
• Recipients are selected based on their **exemplary achievements** and contributions to society.
 
• The awards are announced annually on **Republic Day** and presented by the President of India.
 
 
 
• **Literary Contributions of Tripura:**
 
 
• Tripura has a strong tradition of **literature, poetry, and storytelling**, often reflecting the state’s rich heritage and tribal culture.
 
• Several writers and poets from Tripura have gained national and international recognition for their works.
 
• The state promotes **literary festivals** and events to celebrate its cultural richness.
 
 
 
• **Economists Honored with Padma Shri:**
 
 
• Economists are recognized with the Padma Shri for their contributions to **policy-making, research, and education**.
 
• Many economists who have received this honor have significantly impacted **India’s development and economic strategies**.
 
• Prof. Arunoday Saha’s recognition highlights his **exceptional contributions** to economic studies and literature.
